task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: Navigate CAR to FRONT_CRATE to remove it as an obstacle, then navigate to MEDICINE_BOTTLE, pick it up, navigate to MEDICAL_TABLE, and place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE there.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of CAR that needs to be removed
FRONT_CRATE is graspable and can be picked up by CAR
Removing the obstacle means picking it up and moving it elsewhere (placing it at TEMP_ZONE as a safe location)
After removing FRONT_CRATE, CAR can access MEDICINE_BOTTLE and MEDICAL_TABLE
